newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Supreme Defence Council, chaired by president Emil Constantinescu, continues its session. Several draft laws and a full report on Constantinescu's visit to Poland are on the agenda.
* Constantinescu urged police to be firm in fight against corruption and organised crime, during meeting with police officials on their annual activity report.
* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea met German ambassador Leopold Bill von Bredow, who accompanied a group of leading German investors in Romania.

* Ex-President Ion Iliescu was elected head of the leftist Party of Social Democracy (PDSR) at the opening of the party's national conference. During the afernoon the PDSR is expected to vote the party's new statute and leadership. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
